paper: MarketSenseAI 2.0: Enhancing Stock Analysis through LLM Agents
headline_strategy: Five-agent GPT-4o stock-analysis pipeline in which News, Fundamentals, Dynamics, and Macroeconomic agents feed a Signal agent that issues monthly buy/hold/sell ratings; long-only equal- and capitalization-weighted portfolios hold the buy-rated S&P 100 or S&P 500 stocks
paper_portability_to_common_task: the cadence and U.S. long-only portfolio are directly relevant, but the signal-generation policy is not executable because no operational release, prompts, frozen inputs, signals, or holdings are public
missing_headline_objects: attributable operational code, dependency/runtime configuration, and exact five-agent graph
verbatim prompts, parser, GPT snapshots, inference parameters, seeds and repeated-run protocol
point-in-time S&P constituents and frozen price, news, SEC, transcript, and macro inputs
monthly buy/hold/sell generation records and confidence/explanation outputs
portfolio holdings, cap weights, trades, fills, cash, dividends, costs and NAV paths
VectorBTPro version/configuration, metric formulas, and factor-regression inputs/horizon

rejected_substitutes.route: Implement five generic LLM prompts over current public data
rejected_substitutes.reason: The paper provides no verbatim prompts, data snapshot, parser, model snapshot, timing, seeds, or repeated-run rule, so this would create a new policy.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use JKP characteristics for all four analysis agents
rejected_substitutes.reason: This removes the paper's news, filing/transcript, price-dynamics, and macro-RAG mechanisms rather than adapting their data.

rejected_substitutes.route: Infer buy stocks from aggregate signal counts or plotted portfolios
rejected_substitutes.reason: Counts, performance figures and raster assets do not identify security-level monthly signals or weights.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the later Signal or Noise validation paper
rejected_substitutes.reason: It is a separate 2026 empirical record with different live cohorts and cannot supply missing 2025 strategy outputs.

rejected_substitutes.route: Reuse a thematic local MarketSenseAI proxy
rejected_substitutes.reason: Thematic characteristic mappings contain no native agent mechanism or result provenance.

result_policy: No generic prompt system, JKP-only agent, aggregate-output reconstruction, later-paper result, or thematic proxy is entered as a MarketSenseAI 2.0 return. Its positive monthly portfolio claims remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
